- Scroll Discover with the right stick; L3/R3 keep focus in the catalog.
- Load smaller posters and preload nearby rows for faster browsing.
- Refresh Home when requests made in SlopFin become available.
- Show saved quality on completed requests; align actions and corner controls.
- Reorder or hide categories in Navigation; simplify Settings and Seerr setup.

**Settings** now follows Account, Subtitles, Playback, Audio/Video, Navigation,
Discover, Updates, Diagnostics. Controller is inside Navigation. Home, Discover
and library categories can be hidden or reordered; Settings stays accessible.
New libraries are included automatically. Change Jellyfin servers through Account → Sign out.

**Discover** uses continuous right-stick scrolling, sharper appropriately sized
posters and nearby-row preloading. Title details group actions evenly, keep
Circle/Close at the screen's bottom-right edge, and display the original saved
quality for requested and available titles. Page controls sit at the screen edge.

**Request tracking** checks requests created in SlopFin while the app is open,
including outside Discover. When a movie or requested season becomes available,
Home refreshes in the background. Jellyfin must index imported files before they
can appear; short follow-up refreshes allow the server scan to catch up.

**Connection setup** identifies the Seerr/Jellyseerr/Overseerr server URL and
shows connected, connecting, disconnected and failed states. Updates has a single
primary action without the duplicate Check again shortcut.

Update in **Settings → Updates**, or install the complete **folder ZIP** below.
Sign-in and preferences are preserved. [Update guide](https://github.com/BeLikeBrett/SlopFin/blob/main/docs/UPDATES.md).
